name: Kaylee Egerer
detail: The Herald of 22 Feb 2011 captions her Campus Improvements Chair, a term the archive does not record. It has her in 2008-09 and 2011-12 only, so her portrait had to be filed to the latter.

name: Paige Settles
detail: Recorded twice in the same year, as Page Settles and Paige Settles, both Speaker of the Senate. One person, two spellings. Her own progression, freshman senator in 2012-13, confirms the Herald was right to call her a senior in September 2015 and wrong to call her a junior the following March.

name: Nolan Miles / Noland Miles
detail: Entered twice in the same year under two spellings, as Chair of Public Relations and Chair of Student Affairs. One man: he is Executive Vice President in 1914-15 and 1915-16 as Nolan. His portrait attaches to the Nolan spelling, so the Noland entry reads as a person with no face and inflates the missing count.

name: Spirit Masters booklets 2011-2018
detail: Called the best untapped portrait source by an earlier researcher. All seven were pulled and searched against the whole missing list. Seventeen name matches, and twelve were different people entirely: Steve Todd served 1969-70 and Scott Taylor 1975-76, neither can be in a 2014 booklet. Of the three whose service plausibly overlapped, not one bio mentions student government. The source is spent; do not mine it again.
